info.title: Phase Flag API
info.description:
Phase Flag is an open-source feature flag management platform.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except `/health`) require an API key via:
- **Header**: `X-API-Key: <your-key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <your-key>`

get.description: Return health status with database connectivity check.

post.description: Emergency kill switch: immediately disable a flag and pause its rollout pipelines.

get.description:
Compile and return all active flags as a JSON ruleset.

Supports ETag-based conditional fetch — returns 304 if unchanged.

Return a complete bootstrap payload for offline SDK initialization.

Includes all active flags with full configuration for local evaluation.

post.description: Merge anonymous user flag assignments to an authenticated user identity.

get.description: Evaluate ALL active flags for a given context and return a dict of flag_key -> value.

post.description: Evaluate a flag and return an explanation of why the result was chosen.
Evaluate multiple flags in one call using prerequisite-aware evaluation.

Transition a flag to a new lifecycle stage.

get.description: List flags that haven't been evaluated in 30+ days.

get.description: List flags that are past their expiration date.

Run expiration check: flags past expires_at are auto-archived.
